data.one_liner: Plugin for registering and configuring Android notification channels.
data.what_it_does: Allows Flutter apps to create and configure custom Android notification channels with specific importance levels, sounds, vibrations, and visibility settings. It is often used alongside older versions of Firebase Messaging where native channel configuration is limited.
use_when: You need to register custom notification channels on Android
You are using a messaging plugin that doesn't natively configure Android channels
You need to customize sound, vibration, importance, or badge settings for Android notifications
avoid_when: You are using a modern notification package that already fully handles Android channel creation out-of-the-box
strengths: Simple API to set up Android notification channels
Supports multiple importance levels, visibility options, and custom sounds
weaknesses: Limited primarily to Android channel registration
iOS support is not a core focus as notification channels are an Android-specific concept
data.setup_notes: Requires Android configuration for notification channels as per standard Android development.

alternatives.name: flutter_local_notifications
alternatives.why_pick_it: Provides comprehensive local notification features including built-in management for Android notification channels.

alternatives.name: firebase_messaging
alternatives.why_pick_it: Modern versions handle messaging and channel configurations natively without requiring a separate plugin.

alternatives.name: onesignal_flutter
alternatives.why_pick_it: Complete push notification service that handles delivery and channel setup across platforms.

data.minimal_example:
var result = await FlutterNotificationChannel().registerNotificationChannel(
    description: 'Your channel description',
    id: 'your_channel_id',
    importance: NotificationImportance.IMPORTANCE_HIGH,
    name: 'Your channel name',
    visibility: NotificationVisibility.VISIBILITY_PUBLIC,
    allowBubbles: true,
    enableVibration: true,
    enableSound: true,
    showBadge: true,
);
